subject: 'subscript out of bounds' error when running gl.LDNe()

messages.author: 2a8d2ec95691bbbc
messages.subject: 'subscript out of bounds' error when running gl.LDNe()
parts:
I am trying to fun the gl.LDNe() function using the code below:

nes <- gl.LDNe(subsampled_filtered_dama, neest.path = "S:/Downloads/Zip_Folder_64_bit_191125/Zip_Folder_64_bit_191125", outpath = "S:/Dartseq results - plate 1 - downloaded 190922/Dart results Aug 2022", verbose = 5)

When I run the code, it begins to run, and starts printing outputs in the console and then stops with the error:

Error in CI_low_JackKnife[[i]] : subscript out of bounds

I can run the function successfully on the possums.gl dataset. I have tried the code on my unfiltered SNP dataset, my filtered dataset, and a subsample of my data containing only the first 300 SNPs. However, I get the same error code when I run the script on any of those SNP datasets.

Can you suggest what the issue is here?

messages.author: 592079bda2cb3220
messages.subject: Re: 'subscript out of bounds' error when running gl.LDNe()
parts:
Hi Eliane,

Based on the data you  sent me, the problem was that confidence intervals using the JackKnife method only works in populations with more than two individuals.

I have fixed this bug, so when a population has less than three individuals JackKnife confidence intervals are NA.

To use this updated function, you should install the developing version of dartR by typing in the R console:

library(dartR)
gl.install.vanilla.dartR(flavour = "dev")

Cheers,
Luis
